result.summary: The page is generally polished, but a few elements appear visually clipped or obscured, mostly around horizontally scrolling content and the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlaps the content area. The second restaurant card at the bottom is partially hidden behind the nav bar, making the card feel cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding or safe-area spacing to the scrollable content so cards can scroll fully above the bottom navigation.

issues.description: Several horizontal carousel items are clipped at the right edge, including the category chip after “Healthy” and the third card in “Fastest near you.” This creates a slightly broken-looking partial element.
issues.suggestion: If the partial item is intentional as a scroll hint, ensure it has enough visible width to look deliberate. Otherwise, adjust carousel padding, snapping, or item widths so items are not awkwardly cut off.

issues.description: The third restaurant name in the “Fastest near you” row is cut off at the right edge, making it difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Allow the card to snap fully into view on scroll, or constrain visible carousel items so restaurant names are not truncated by the viewport edge.
